briefing: Markets were modestly positive today with NASDAQ +0.9% and S&P 500 +0.5%, a neutral-to-slightly-bullish backdrop. With three open slots and cash above the $500 deployment threshold, we filled positions with our highest-conviction screened candidate (NWCL, full multi-signal confirmation) plus two solid momentum names (ALMR, MP) to diversify away from our semiconductor-heavy existing book.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a moving average crossover, healthy RSI, price above a key average, and a volume spike — to all line up before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false breakout, since several indicators agreeing suggests real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前等待多個技術訊號同時出現，例如均線交叉、健康的RSI水平、價格高於關鍵均線，以及成交量放大，而不是僅依賴單一訊號進場。這樣可以降低追高假突破的風險，因為多項指標同時符合，通常代表真實的買盤力量，而非隨機波動。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today, with the S&P 500 up 0.5% and the NASDAQ up 0.9%, reflecting steady but unspectacular risk appetite rather than any single catalyst. Small-cap and mid-cap momentum names showed stronger relative strength than mega-caps, consistent with continued rotation into growth names with fresh technical breakouts. No major macro data releases stood out today, so price action was largely driven by sector-level positioning and individual earnings/technical setups.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚，標普500指數升0.5%，納斯達克指數升0.9%，反映市場風險偏好穩健但並無特別亮點。相對於大型股，中小型動能股表現更為強勁，顯示資金持續輪動至具備技術突破訊號的成長股。今日並無重大宏觀經濟數據公布，價格走勢主要受個股技術面及板塊資金流向主導。
